title: Conversation Timeline Projection Checkpoint Safe View
description: A bounded, non-sensitive view of one projector/source-stream checkpoint. The checkpoint is a scan optimization only; Source Binding remains the idempotency defense and the checkpoint is never a business fact source.

projector_name.description: The only P2-002 projector identity. A second projector is outside this task's rebuild semantics.

cursor_value.description: An opaque bounded source cursor. It must not contain source content or external identities.

row_version.description: A canonical positive decimal integer string. Runtime validation additionally caps it at PostgreSQL BIGINT maximum and never converts it to JavaScript Number.

x-consistency-boundary: The checkpoint advances in the same database transaction as Conversation Item and Source Binding.
